phrases.text_l1: مرحبا كيفكن؟ ان شاء الله كل شي تمام
phrases.text_l2: Hello, how are you all? Hopefully everything is fine.
And everything is good with you.

phrases.text_l1: أنا مها وهيدي التشانل لكل الأشخاص
phrases.text_l2: I'm Maha, and this is the channel for everyone
who are learning Arabic
and want to hear something in Arabic
in the Lebanese dialect.

phrases.text_l1: مثل العادة أنا رح إحكي عالبطيء
phrases.text_l2: As usual, I'm going to speak slowly

phrases.text_l1: أو ما رح إحكي كتير بسرعة.
phrases.text_l2: or I won't speak very fast.
Also, you can listen
and watch the subtitles
or read the subtitles
meaning the translation in Arabic, in English
or in any other language.
Let's get started.

phrases.text_l1: اليوم بدي خبركن شوي عن أنا شو عملت
phrases.text_l2: Today I want to tell you a bit about what I did
yesterday and the day before yesterday,
what happened to me
and where I am now.

phrases.text_l1: من يومين، يعني نهار التلاتا الصبح،
phrases.text_l2: Two days ago, meaning Tuesday morning,
I traveled.
What does it mean I traveled?
Meaning I was in a country, in Lebanon,
in my country, Lebanon,

phrases.text_l1: وسافرت وإجيت هلق على بلد تاني
phrases.text_l2: and I traveled and came now to another country
which is Russia.
Meaning I'm not in Lebanon now,
I'm in Russia.
And I came here suddenly,
because of the war,
meaning because of the situation in Lebanon.
Now maybe you know
or you don't know,
there is a war in Lebanon

phrases.text_l1: والوضع مش كتير منيح وكتير صعب.
phrases.text_l2: and the situation is not very good and very difficult.
So that's why I traveled here,
me with my son.

phrases.text_l1: وأنا يعني بحب كتير إجي لهون
phrases.text_l2: And I really love coming here
to Russia,

phrases.text_l1: بس أنا ما كان بدي سافر هلق،
phrases.text_l2: but I didn't want to travel now,

phrases.text_l1: لأنو هلق هون في كتير برد.
phrases.text_l2: because now here it is very cold.
Here the weather is very cold
and very different from Lebanon.
Meaning in Lebanon last week
it was very hot
and the temperature was like twenty during the day,
and here we arrived here two days ago
there was snow.

phrases.text_l1: تلج والحرارة يمكن كانت ناقص واحد
phrases.text_l2: Snow and the temperature was maybe minus one
or minus two.
So this thing is very difficult, I mean.

phrases.text_l1: بس مش مشكلة، شو بدنا نعمل؟
phrases.text_l2: But no problem, what can we do?
There are circumstances now

phrases.text_l1: وعشان هيك نحن مضطرين إنو نسافر.
phrases.text_l2: and that's why we are forced to travel.
Now I'm here, where am I?
I'm at my brother's house.

phrases.text_l1: وخيي عايش هون بموسكو من زمان،
phrases.text_l2: And my brother has been living here in Moscow for a while,
maybe for like twenty years.
And he lives here, he works here.

phrases.text_l1: بس أنا ما رح إبقى هون ببيت خيي،
phrases.text_l2: But I'm not going to stay here at my brother's house,

phrases.text_l1: اليوم أنا بدي روح على مدينة تانية،
phrases.text_l2: today I want to go to another city,
and there in the other city is my aunt's house.
My aunt, my grandmother, my aunt's husband, and her children.

phrases.text_l1: فهلق أنا رح فرجيكن شوي الفيو
phrases.text_l2: So now I'm going to show you a bit of the view
from here from my brother's house,
and let's go see.
This is the view from my brother's house,
very, very nice.

phrases.text_l1: نحن هون على الطابق الواحد وعشرين،
phrases.text_l2: We are here on the twenty-first floor,

phrases.text_l1: عشان هيك نحن كتير عاليين عن الأرض.
phrases.text_l2: that's why we are very high above the ground.

phrases.text_l1: ومثل ما شايفين تحت في كتير سيارات،
phrases.text_l2: And as you can see below there are many cars,
and there is a car now moving,

phrases.text_l1: وفي شخص كمان عم يمشي ع الطريق،
phrases.text_l2: and there is a person also walking on the road,
more than one person,

phrases.text_l1: في كتير ناس عم يمشوا ع الطريق.
phrases.text_l2: there are many people walking on the road.

phrases.text_l1: وهون ع الشمال في مدرسة لونها أورونج،
phrases.text_l2: And here on the left there is a school, its color orange,
and there are games also below for the kids.
And there in the face, meaning in front of me,
there are very nice houses.
Also in front of me, meaning behind the houses,
there is a forest.

phrases.text_l1: مثل ما عم بتشوفوا في كتير شجر،
phrases.text_l2: As you can see there are many trees,
and this is a forest,
people go there to walk,
meaning they walk with their family,
with their kids, with their friends.
And this is the view from here,
very, very nice honestly.

phrases.text_l1: وهلق مبارح كان في كتير تلج،
phrases.text_l2: And now yesterday there was a lot of snow,

phrases.text_l1: ما بعرف هلق إذا قادرين تشوفوا،
phrases.text_l2: I don't know now if you can see,
there is a bit of snow on the ground
on the side of the road,
but now it melted today
because the temperature today
became above zero,
five above zero,
that's why everything melted
and there is no snow now today.
And regarding the trip,
for our trip from Lebanon to Russia,
it was definitely by plane,
and it was very difficult and very long.
Now I will tell you why.
Usually from Lebanon to Russia
the trip doesn't take much time

phrases.text_l1: لأنو روسيا مش كتير بعيدة عن لبنان.
phrases.text_l2: because Russia is not very far from Lebanon.
Usually by plane it takes like three
or four hours,
but now because of the war
between Russia and Ukraine,
the Russian plane cannot fly
over Ukraine,
that's why the trip becomes longer
and it becomes total maybe like
eight hours or nine hours.

phrases.text_l1: هلق أنا ما بعرف قديه رح إبقى هون،
phrases.text_l2: Now I don't know how long I will stay here,

phrases.text_l1: كل شي بيعتمد على الوضع بلبنان،
phrases.text_l2: everything depends on the situation in Lebanon,
meaning according to the situation in Lebanon.
If the situation in Lebanon is good,
we might return,

phrases.text_l1: وإذا كان الوضع بلبنان مش منيح،
phrases.text_l2: and if the situation in Lebanon is not good,
we will stay here.

phrases.text_l1: وكمان بتمنى أو إنو ان شاء الله
phrases.text_l2: And also I hope, or God willing,
we will be comfortable here,

phrases.text_l1: وان شاء الله أنا إقدر إشتغل منيح.
phrases.text_l2: and God willing I will be able to work well.
And this was everything for today,
I'll see you all God willing soon
in a new video.

phrases.text_l1: وإذا عندكن أي سؤال اكتبولي بالكومنت
phrases.text_l2: And if you have any question write to me in the comments
and tell me what is your opinion,
or what you like to hear
or what you like to attend.

phrases.text_l1: وكمان إذا انتو أوريدي عم تتعلموا عربي
phrases.text_l2: And also if you already are learning Arabic
you can go see the podcast
and listen to the podcast 'Come With Me in Arabic',
I'll see you all God willing soon,
Goodbye.
